ns2:group.ns2:description:
Is the $1,499 Framework Laptop 13 Pro the "MacBook Pro for Linux users"? I'm not sure -- but it's the best-feeling modular laptop the company's yet made! The first-for-Framework CNC machined aluminum chassis is a huge part of that. We got to give it a spin, even tear it down, and the touchpad and keyboard feel pretty dang good without interfering with modularity. Will the new Core Ultra Series 3, LPCAMM2 memory and larger battery add up to MacBook Pro beating battery life and performance? We'll have to wait and see in a full review after it launches in June.

The Apple HomePod mini just crossed a major milestone, 2,000 days without a single hardware update. That’s nearly five and a half years of the same S5 chip, same design, and same internals since 2020.
In this video, we break down why Apple hasn’t updated the HomePod mini, what’s been going on behind the scenes with Siri, and why the next generation has reportedly been finished for months.
According to Mark Gurman, Apple is holding back not just the HomePod mini, but also a new full-sized HomePod and Apple TV until a completely revamped Siri is ready to launch.
We also dive into everything rumored for the next HomePod mini, including: • A massive chip upgrade (S9 or newer) • New wireless tech with an N1 chip • Wi-Fi 6E or Wi-Fi 7 support • Improved sound quality • Potential Apple Intelligence integration
With WWDC 2026 right around the corner, Apple could be preparing its biggest smart home reset yet.
If Apple gets Siri right, this could completely change how the HomePod fits into the ecosystem.
